deadline.u: Biz ushbu hisobotni juma kungi qat'iy muddatdan oldin tugatishimiz kerak.

colleague.s: My friendly colleague helped me finish the difficult office task.
colleague.u: Mehribon hamkasbim menga qiyin idora vazifasini bajarishga yordam berdi.

contract.s: They signed a new business contract for the next two years.
contract.u: Ular kelgusi ikki yil uchun yangi biznes shartnomasini imzolashdi.

resign.s: He decided to resign from his job after a big disagreement.
resign.u: U katta kelishmovchilikdan keyin o'z ishidan bo'shashga qaror qildi.

retire.s: My grandfather plans to retire from work at the age of sixty-five.
retire.u: Bobom oltmish besh yoshida ishdan nafaqaga chiqishni rejalashtirmoqda.

download.s: You can download this free app on your phone.
download.u: Siz bu bepul ilovani telefoningizga yuklab olishingiz mumkin.

upload.s: Please upload your homework to the school website.
upload.u: Iltimos, uy vazifangizni maktab veb-saytiga yuklang.

website.s: This website has a lot of useful English lessons.
website.u: Bu veb-saytda ko'p foydali ingliz tili darslari bor.

email.s: I sent an important email to my teacher today.
email.u: Men bugun o'qituvchimga muhim elektron pochta yubordim.

signal.s: We have a very weak internet signal here.
signal.u: Bu yerda internet signali juda zaif.

connect.s: Connect your laptop to the Wi-Fi network easily.

sad.s: She felt sad because she lost her favorite pen.
sad.u: U sevimli ruchkasini yo'qotgani uchun o'zini xafa his qildi.

angry.s: My father was angry when I broke the window.
angry.u: Men derazani sindirganimda otam achchiqlangan edi.

nervous.s: He gets nervous before speaking in front of people.
nervous.u: U odamlar oldida gapirishdan oldin xavotirda bo'ladi.

excited.s: The children are excited about going to the zoo.

worried.s: She looks worried about her upcoming English test.
worried.u: U yaqinlashib kelayotgan ingliz tili testidan tashvishli ko'rinadi.

proud.s: Parents are always proud of their children's good results.
proud.u: Ota-onalar doimo farzandlarining yaxshi natijalaridan faxrlanishadi.

jealous.s: He felt jealous when his friend got a new bike.
jealous.u: Do'sti yangi velosiped olganida u rashk qildi.

bored.s: The students were bored during the very long lesson.
bored.u: Juda uzun dars paytida o'quvchilar zerikkan edilar.

interested.s: Are you interested in learning new foreign languages?
interested.u: Siz yangi chet tillarini o'rganishga qiziqasizmi?

surprised.s: We were surprised by the unexpected birthday party yesterday.
surprised.u: Kecha kutilmagan tug'ilgan kun ziyofatidan biz hayron qoldik.

lonely.s: Old people sometimes feel lonely when nobody visits them.
lonely.u: Keksa odamlar ba'zan hech kim ularni ko'rgani kelmaganda yolg'iz his qilishadi.

think.s: What do you think about this wonderful new movie?
think.u: Siz bu ajoyib yangi kino haqida nima o'ylaysiz?

last week.s: I visited my grandparents last week.
last week.u: Men oʻtgan hafta buvim va bobomnikiga bordim.

last month.s: She bought a new car last month.
last month.u: U oʻtgan oy yangi mashina sotib oldi.

last year.s: They travelled to England last year.
last year.u: Ular oʻtgan yili Angliyaga sayohat qilishdi.

two days ago.s: I met my old friend two days ago.
two days ago.u: Men ikki kun oldin eski doʻstimni uchratdim.

ago.s: We arrived in the city three days ago.
ago.u: Biz uch kun oldin shaharga yetib keldik.

went.s: We went to the park yesterday.

saw.s: I saw a big cat in the garden.

visited.s: My uncle visited us on Sunday.
visited.u: Togʻam biznikiga yakshanba kuni tashrif buyurdi.

travelled.s: He travelled to many different countries last year.
travelled.u: U oʻtgan yili koʻplab turli mamlakatlarga sayohat qildi.

studied.s: She studied English for two hours yesterday.
studied.u: U kecha ikki soat davomida ingliz tilini oʻqidi.

worked.s: My father worked at the hospital last year.

played.s: The children played football in the yard.

ate.s: We ate a delicious dinner at home.
ate.u: Biz uyda mazali kechki ovqat yedik.

drank.s: She drank a glass of cold water.
drank.u: U bir stakan sovuq suv ichdi.

slept.s: The baby slept for eight hours last night.

wrote.s: He wrote a long letter to his friend.

met.s: I met my teacher at the local market.

finished.s: She finished her homework before dinner time.
finished.u: U kechki ovqat vaqtidan oldin uy vazifasini tugatdi.

next week.s: We will start a new project next week.
next week.u: Biz keyingi hafta yangi loyihani boshlaymiz.

soon.s: They will come back home very soon.
soon.u: Ular juda tez orada uyga qaytib kelishadi.

will.s: I will help you with your homework.
will.u: Men senga uy vazifangni bajarishga yordam beraman.

going to.s: We are going to visit our friends tomorrow.

plan.s: We have a good plan for the weekend.
plan.u: Bizda dam olish kunlari uchun yaxshi reja bor.

decide.s: You need to decide which book to buy.
decide.u: Siz qaysi kitobni sotib olishni hal qilishingiz kerak.

than.s: My house is bigger than your house.

as … as.s: This book is as good as that one.

similar.s: Our new cars look very similar today.
similar.u: Bizning yangi mashinalarimiz bugun juda o‘xshash ko‘rinmoqda.

different.s: My brother and I like different music.
different.u: Akam ikkimiz har xil musiqani yoqtiramiz.

compare.s: Please compare these two cheap phones.
compare.u: Iltimos, bu ikkita arzon telefonni taqqoslang.

weight.s: I need to check my weight today.
weight.u: Men bugun o‘z vaznimni tekshirishim kerak.

height.s: What is the height of this door?

cheaper.s: This red shirt is cheaper than that.
cheaper.u: Bu qizil ko‘ylak anaviga qaraganda arzonroq.

head.s: I have a big pain in my head.

hand.s: Please take my hand when we walk.

leg.s: He hurt his leg during the game.
leg.u: U o‘yin paytida oyog‘ini jarohatlab oldi.

back.s: My back hurts after long work hours.
back.u: Uzoq ish soatlaridan keyin orqam og‘riyapti.

pain.s: Do you feel any pain in your arm?

fever.s: The sick child has a high fever.

cough.s: She has a bad cough this morning.
cough.u: Bugun ertalab uning yomg‘ir yo‘tali bor.

tired.s: I feel very tired after long work.
tired.u: Uzoq ishdan keyin o‘zimni juda charchagan his qilyapman.

trousers.s: I want to buy new blue trousers.
trousers.u: Men yangi ko‘k shim sotib olmoqchiman.

scarf.s: She wears a warm red scarf today.
scarf.u: U bugun issiq qizil sharf taqib yuribdi.

fit.s: These new shoes fit my feet well.
fit.u: Bu yangi poyabzallar oyog‘imga yaxshi mos tushyapti.

wear.s: I usually wear a jacket in winter.

try on.s: Can I try on this blue shirt?
try on.u: Bu ko‘k ko‘ylakni kiyib ko‘rsam bo‘ladimi?

style.s: I really like your new fashion style.
style.u: Sizning yangi moda uslubingiz menga juda yoqadi.

comfortable.s: These shoes are very comfortable for walking.
comfortable.u: Bu poyabzallar sayr qilish uchun juda qulay.

metro.s: We take the fast metro to work.

maybe.s: Maybe we can go to the park tomorrow.

perhaps.s: Perhaps she will help us with this work.
perhaps.u: Ehtimol u bizga bu ishda yordam berar.

hope.s: I hope you have a really great day.
hope.u: Umid qilamanki, kuningiz juda yaxshi oʻtadi.

promise.s: Please promise me you will be very careful.
promise.u: Iltimos, menga juda ehtiyot boʻlishingizni vaʼda bering.

meeting.s: Our team meeting starts at ten o'clock today.
meeting.u: Bizning jamoa yigʻilishimiz bugun soat oʻnda boshlanadi.

arrive.s: They will arrive at the station very soon.
arrive.u: Ular stansiyaga juda tez orada yetib kelishadi.

schedule.s: My work schedule is very busy this week.
schedule.u: Bu hafta mening ish jadvalim juda band.

already.s: I have already finished reading this interesting book.
already.u: Men bu qiziqarli kitobni oʻqib boʻlganman.

just.s: He has just walked into the living room.

yet.s: Have you finished your difficult homework yet?
yet.u: Siz qiyin uy vazifangizni hali tugatdingizmi?

since.s: She has lived in this city since 2015.

for.s: We have waited for the bus for twenty minutes.
for.u: Biz yigirma daqiqa davomida avtobusni kutdik.

recently.s: I bought a new phone very recently.
recently.u: Men yaqinda yangi telefon sotib oldim.

lately.s: She has been very busy with her studies lately.
lately.u: U keyingi paytda oʻqishi bilan juda band boʻldi.

experience.s: Traveling to new places is a wonderful life experience.
experience.u: Yangi joylarga sayohat qilish ajoyib hayotiy tajribadir.

abroad.s: My brother wants to study at a university abroad.
abroad.u: Mening akam chet eldagi universitetda oʻqishni xohlaydi.

twice.s: I have visited historical Samarkand twice before.
twice.u: Men ilgari tarixiy Samarqandga ikki marta borganman.

so far.s: We have read four interesting chapters so far.
so far.u: Biz hozirgacha toʻrtta qiziqarli bobni oʻqib chiqdik.

achieve.s: Work hard if you want to achieve your goals.
achieve.u: Agar maqsadlaringizga erishmoqchi boʻlsangiz, qattiq ishlang.

better.s: This small red car is much better than that.
better.u: Bu kichkina qizil mashina narigidan ancha yaxshiroq.

worse.s: The weather today is much worse than yesterday.

more.s: We need to buy more fresh fruit today.
more.u: Biz bugun koʻproq yangi meva sotib olishimiz kerak.

less.s: You should drink less sweet soda every day.
less.u: Siz har kuni kamroq shirin gazli suv ichishingiz kerak.

the best.s: My mother makes the best food in the world.
the best.u: Mening onam dunyodagi eng yaxshi ovqatni tayyorlaydi.

extinct.s: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago on our planet.
extinct.u: Dinozavrlar millionlab yillar oldin sayyoramizda qirilib ketgan.

aware.s: You must be aware of the potential risks before signing.
aware.u: Siz imzo qoʻyishdan oldin yuzaga kelishi mumkin boʻlgan xavflardan xabardor boʻlishingiz kerak.

device.s: This smart electronic device helps me manage my daily schedule.
device.u: Bu aqlli elektron qurilma menga kundalik jadvalimni boshqarishga yordam beradi.

data.s: We need to analyze all the customer data carefully this week.
data.u: Biz bu hafta barcha mijozlar maʼlumotlarini diqqat bilan tahlil qilishimiz kerak.

software.s: You should install the latest security software on your laptop today.
software.u: Siz bugun noutbugingizga soʻnggi xavfsizlik dasturini oʻrnatishingiz kerak.

update.s: Remember to update your mobile phone application to the newest version.
update.u: Mobil telefoningiz ilovasini eng yangi versiyaga yangilashni unutmang.

artificial intelligence.s: Artificial intelligence is changing how we work and live every day.
artificial intelligence.u: Sunʼiy intellekt bizning har kundagi ishimiz va hayotimizni oʻzgartirmoqda.

robot.s: The friendly robot cleaned the living room floor in a few minutes.
robot.u: Mehribon robot yashash xonasi polini bir necha daqiqada tozaladi.

improve.s: Reading books every single day will significantly improve your English vocabulary.
improve.u: Har kuni kitob oʻqish ingliz tili lugʻat boyligingizni sezilarli darajada yaxshilaydi.

digital.s: Most people today prefer reading digital books on their tablet screens.
digital.u: Bugungi kunda koʻpchilik planshet ekranida raqamli kitoblar oʻqishni afzal koʻradi.

network.s: Our company uses a secure local network to share important files.
network.u: Kompaniyamiz muhim fayllarni ulashish uchun xavfsiz mahalliy tarmoqdan foydalanadi.

security.s: Airport security checks take a little more time during busy hours.
security.u: Aeroport xavfsizlik tekshiruvlari gavjum soatlarda biroz koʻproq vaqt oladi.

store.s: You can store all your precious photos safely in cloud storage.
store.u: Siz barcha qimmatbaho suratlaringizni bulutli xotirada xavfsiz saqlashingiz mumkin.

generate.s: This solar panel can generate enough electricity for our whole house.
generate.u: Bu quyosh batareyasi butun uyimiz uchun yetarli darajada elektr energiyasi yarata oladi.

efficient.s: Working from home can sometimes be much more efficient for office employees.
efficient.u: Uyda ishlash baʼzida ofis xodimlari uchun ancha samaraliroq boʻlishi mumkin.

convenient.s: Online shopping is very convenient because you do not leave home.
convenient.u: Onlayn xarid qilish juda qulay, chunki uydan chiqolmaysiz.

culture.s: Traveling to foreign countries helps you learn about their unique culture.
culture.u: Chet elga sayohat qilish ularning oʻziga xos madaniyati haqida bilib olishingizga yordam beradi.

tradition.s: Making delicious plov on weekends is a wonderful family tradition here.
tradition.u: Dam olish kunlarida mazali palov tayyorlash bu yerda ajoyib oilaviy anʼanadir.

custom.s: It is an ancient local custom to welcome guests with hot tea.
custom.u: Mehmonlarni issiq choy bilan kutib olish qadimiy mahalliy urf-odatdir.

festival.s: Thousands of cheerful people gathered in the city center for the festival.
festival.u: Minglab quvnoq odamlar festival uchun shahar markaziga yigʻilishdi.

ceremony.s: The graduation ceremony will take place in the main university hall.
ceremony.u: Bitiruv marosimi universitetning asosiy zalida boʻlib oʻtadi.

wedding.s: All our relatives and close friends came to celebrate our wedding.
wedding.u: Barcha qarindoshlarimiz va yaqin doʻstlarimiz toʻyimizni nishonlash uchun kelishdi.

celebrate.s: We always gather together with our family to celebrate the New Year.
celebrate.u: Biz har doim Yangi yilni nishonlash uchun oilamiz bilan birga yigʻilamiz.

respect.s: Students should always show deep respect to their teachers and parents.
respect.u: Oʻquvchilar har doim oʻqituvchilari va ota-onalariga chuqur hurmat koʻrsatishlari kerak.

reason.s: She could not give a good reason for being late.
reason.u: U kech qolganining yaxshi sababini ayta olmadi.

evidence.s: The police found new evidence at the crime scene.
evidence.u: Politsiya jinoyat joyidan yangi dalil topdi.

suggest.s: Can you suggest a good restaurant for our dinner?
suggest.u: Kechki ovqatimiz uchun yaxshi restoranni tavsiya qila olasizmi?

convince.s: He tried to convince his parents to buy a car.
convince.u: U ota-onasini mashina sotib olishga ishontirishga harakat qildi.

discuss.s: We need to discuss this important problem with the team.
discuss.u: Biz bu muhim muammoni jamoa bilan muhokama qilishimiz kerak.

conclusion.s: It is difficult to reach a conclusion without enough information.
conclusion.u: Yetarli ma'lumot bo'lmaganda xulosaga kelish qiyin.

who.s: The man who helped me yesterday is a talented doctor.
who.u: Kecha menga yordam bergan erkak iqtidorli shifokor.

which.s: She bought a new laptop which works extremely fast.
which.u: U juda tez ishlaydigan yangi noutbuk sotib oldi.

that.s: I really like the shoes that you are wearing today.
that.u: Bugun siz kiyib yurgan tuflilar menga juda yoqadi.

where.s: This is the quiet library where I usually study alone.
where.u: Bu men odatda yolg'iz o'qiydigan sokin kutubxona.

whom.s: The teacher whom we respect the most is retiring soon.
whom.u: Biz eng ko'p hurmat qiladigan o'qituvchi tez orada nafaqaga chiqadi.

defining.s: A defining relative clause gives essential information about the noun.
defining.u: Aniqlovchi nisbiy gap ot haqida muhim ma'lumot beradi.

non-defining.s: A non-defining clause uses commas to separate extra information.
non-defining.u: Aniqlovchi bo'lmagan gap qo'shimcha ma'lumotni ajratish uchun vergullardan foydalanadi.

relative clause.s: A relative clause usually starts with words like who or which.
relative clause.u: Nisbiy gap odatda kim yoki qaysi kabi so'zlar bilan boshlanadi.

antecedent.s: The antecedent is the noun that the relative pronoun refers to.
antecedent.u: Oldingi so'z - bu nisbiy olmosh murojaat qiladigan ot.

combine.s: You can combine these two short sentences using a relative pronoun.
combine.u: Siz bu ikki qisqa gapni nisbiy olmosh yordamida birlashtirishingiz mumkin.

modify.s: An adjective is a word that is used to modify a noun.
modify.u: Sifat - bu otni aniqlash uchun ishlatiladigan so'z.

clause.s: Every complete sentence must contain at least one main clause.
clause.u: Har bir tugallangan gap kamida bitta asosiy gapni o'z ichiga olishi kerak.

pronoun.s: A pronoun is a word that replaces a noun in sentences.
pronoun.u: Olmosh - bu gaplarda otning o'rnini bosadigan so'z.

said.s: He said that he would finish the project by tomorrow.

asked.s: The police officer asked me where I parked my car.
asked.u: Politsiya xodimi mendan mashinamni qayerga qo'yganimni so'radi.

reported speech.s: Reported speech changes the original tense when we speak later.
reported speech.u: O'zlashtirilgan gap keyinroq gapirganimizda asl zamonni o'zgartiradi.

direct speech.s: Direct speech uses quotation marks to show the exact words spoken.
direct speech.u: To'g'ridan-to'g'ri gap aytilgan aniq so'zlarni ko'rsatish uchun qo'shtirnoqdan foydalanadi.

indirect speech.s: Indirect speech allows us to report what someone else said earlier.
indirect speech.u: Bilvosita gap boshqa birov ilgari aytgan gaplarni yetkazishimizga imkon beradi.

claimed.s: The suspect claimed that he was innocent of the crime.
claimed.u: Gumonlanuvchi jinoyatda aybsiz ekanligini da'vo qildi.

explained.s: The science teacher explained how gravity works on planet Earth.
explained.u: Tabiiy fan o'qituvchisi Yer sayyorasida tortishish kuchi qanday ishlashini tushuntirdi.

admitted.s: He finally admitted that he had made a huge mistake.
admitted.u: U nihoyat katta xatoga yo'l qo'yganini tan oldi.

promised.s: She promised that she would help me with my homework.
promised.u: U uy vazifamda menga yordam berishiga va'da berdi.

reminded.s: My mother reminded me to buy some milk on the way.
reminded.u: Onam yo'lda biroz sut sotib olishimni eslatdi.

warned.s: The weather forecast warned us that a heavy storm was coming.
warned.u: Ob-havo ma'lumoti kuchli bo'ron kelayotgani haqida bizni ogohlantirdi.

according to.s: According to the latest weather forecast, it will rain heavily tomorrow.
according to.u: So‘nggi ob-havo ma'lumotiga ko‘ra, ertaga qattiq yomg‘ir yog‘adi.

mentioned.s: She mentioned that she would arrive a little bit later today.
mentioned.u: U bugun biroz kechroq kelishini eslatib o‘tdi.

enjoy.s: I always enjoy listening to soft music while working at home.
enjoy.u: Uyda ishlayotganimda har doim yumshoq musiqa tinglashni yoqtiraman.

avoid.s: You should try to avoid eating fast food late at night.
avoid.u: Siz kechasi kech fast-food yeyishdan qochishga harakat qilishingiz kerak.

mind.s: Would you mind opening the window for some fresh air?
mind.u: Bir oz toza havo kirishi uchun derazani ochishga qarshi emasmisiz?

refuse.s: He had to refuse the job offer because the salary was low.
refuse.u: Maosh kam bo‘lgani uchun u ish taklifini rad etishga majbur bo‘ldi.

manage.s: Despite heavy traffic, she managed to arrive at the meeting on time.
manage.u: Qattiq tirbandlikka qaramay, u uchrashuvga o‘z vaqtida yetib kelishni uddaladi.

pretend.s: He tried to pretend that he was sleeping when I entered.
pretend.u: Men kirganimda u uxlayotganini qilib o‘zini ko‘rsatishga harakat qildi.

recommend.s: Can you recommend a good restaurant for dinner in this city?
recommend.u: Bu shaharda kechki ovqat uchun yaxshi restoranni tavsiya qila olasizmi?

practise.s: You need to practise speaking English every single day to improve.
practise.u: Rivojlanish uchun har kuni ingliz tilida gapirishni mashq qilishingiz kerak.

give up.s: Never give up on your dreams, no matter how hard things get.
give up.u: Ishlar qanchalik qiyin bo‘lmasin, o‘z orzularingizdan aslo voz kechmang.

look after.s: My sister will look after our pets while we are on holiday.
look after.u: Biz ta'tilda bo‘lganimizda opam uy hayvonlarimizga qaraydi.

find out.s: We need to find out the truth about what happened yesterday.
find out.u: Kecha nima sodir bo‘lgani haqidagi haqiqatni bilib olishimiz kerak.

put off.s: They decided to put off the meeting until next Monday morning.
put off.u: Ular uchrashuvni kelgusi dushanba tongiga qadar kechiktirishga qaror qilishdi.

carry on.s: Please carry on reading the text from where you stopped earlier.
carry on.u: Iltimos, matnni oldin to‘xtagan joyingizdan o‘qishni davom ettiring.

turn down.s: She had to turn down the invitation because she was busy.
turn down.u: Band bo‘lgani sababli u taklifni rad etishga majbur bo‘ldi.

bring up.s: It is not easy to bring up children in a big city.
bring up.u: Katta shaharda bolalarni tarbiyalamoq oson emas.

come across.s: I happened to come across my old school photos in the drawer.
come across.u: Men tortmada eski maktab suratlarimga tasodifan duch kelib qoldim.

get along.s: Despite their different personalities, they get along with each other very well.
get along.u: Turli xarakterlarga ega bo‘lishlariga qaramay, ular bir-birlari bilan juda yaxshi munosabatda.

run out of.s: We are about to run out of milk, so please buy some.
run out of.u: Sutimiz tugab qolish arafasida, shuning uchun iltimos biroz sotib oling.

take up.s: He decided to take up photography as a new hobby this year.
take up.u: U bu yil yangi sevimli mashg‘ulot sifatida suratga olishni boshlashga qaror qildi.

figure out.s: It took me hours to figure out how this software works.
figure out.u: Bu dastur qanday ishlashini tushunib olishim uchun bir necha soat vaqt ketdi.

look forward to.s: I am really looking forward to visiting my grandparents this weekend.
look forward to.u: Men bu dam olish kunlari buva va buvimnikiga borishni chin dildan intizorlik bilan kutayapman.

break down.s: My car decided to break down on the middle of the highway.
break down.u: Mashinam avtomagistralning qoq o‘rtasida buzilib qoldi.

investment.s: Making a smart investment in renewable energy is crucial for our future.
investment.u: Qayta tiklanadigan energiyaga aqlli investitsiya kiritish kelajagimiz uchun juda muhim.

loss.s: The company reported a major financial loss after the failed product launch.
loss.u: Kompaniya muvaffaqiyatsiz mahsulot taqdimotidan keyin katta moliyaviy zarar haqida xabar berdi.

budget.s: We need to carefully plan our monthly budget to save more money.
budget.u: Ko'proq pul tejash uchun oylik budjetimizni sinchkovlik bilan rejalashtirishimiz kerak.

loan.s: She applied for a bank loan to buy her first apartment.
loan.u: U birinchi xaridorlik kvartirasini sotib olish uchun bank kreditiga ariza berdi.

interest.s: The bank offers a low interest rate on housing loans this year.
interest.u: Bank bu yil uy-joy kreditlariga past foiz stavkasini taklif qilmoqda.

shareholder.s: Every shareholder voted in favor of the new business strategy today.
shareholder.u: Bugun har bir aksiyador yangi biznes strategiyasi yoqlab ovoz berdi.

merge.s: The two competing technology companies decided to merge last month.
merge.u: Ikki raqobatbardosh texnologiya kompaniyasi o'tgan oy qo'shilishga qaror qildi.

negotiate.s: They spent hours trying to negotiate a better deal with suppliers.
negotiate.u: Ular ta'minotchilar bilan yaxshiroq kelishuv tuzish uchun soatlab muzokara qilishdi.

forecast.s: Economic experts forecast a steady market growth for the next quarter.
forecast.u: Iqtisodiy ekspertlar kelgusi chorak uchun barqaror bozor o'sishini bashorat qilmoqdalar.

growth.s: Continuous economic growth helps to create many new jobs for young people.
growth.u: Uzluksiz iqtisodiy o'sish yoshlar uchun ko'plab yangi ish o'rinlarini yaratishga yordam beradi.

expense.s: We must reduce unnecessary office expense to improve our annual profit.
expense.u: Yillik foydamizni oshirish uchun keraksiz ofis xarajatlarini kamaytirishimiz shart.

market.s: Small businesses must adapt quickly to survive in this competitive market.
market.u: Kichik bizneslar ushbu raqobatbardosh bozorda omon qolish uchun tezda moslashishlari kerak.

symptom.s: A high fever is often the first symptom of a serious flu.
symptom.u: Yuqori isitma ko'pincha jiddiy grippning birinchi belgisi hisoblanadi.

treatment.s: Early medical treatment is essential for a fast and complete recovery.
treatment.u: Tez va to'liq tuzalib ketish uchun erta tibbiy davolash muhim ahamiyatga ega.

diagnosis.s: An accurate diagnosis from the doctor helped her start the right therapy.
diagnosis.u: Shifokorning aniq tashxisi unga to'g'ri muolajani boshlashga yordam berdi.

infection.s: Regular hand washing is the best way to prevent any bacterial infection.
infection.u: Muntazam qo'l yuvish har qanday bakterial infeksiyaning oldini olishning eng yaxshi usuli.

vaccine.s: Millions of people received the new flu vaccine before winter started.
vaccine.u: Qish boshlanishidan oldin millionlab odamlar yangi gripp emini olishdi.

immunity.s: Eating healthy food and sleeping well helps to boost your natural immunity.
immunity.u: Sog'lom ovqatlanish va yaxshi uxlash tabiiy immunitetingizni oshirishga yordam beradi.

nutrition.s: Proper nutrition is extremely important for children during their growth years.
nutrition.u: To'g'ri ovqatlanish bolalar o'sish yillarida o'ta muhim ahamiyatga ega.

recovery.s: His quick recovery amazed all the doctors at the local hospital.
recovery.u: Uning tezda tiklanishi mahalliy shifoxonadagi barcha shifokorlarni hayratda qoldirdi.

chronic.s: She takes daily medication to manage her chronic back pain effectively.
chronic.u: U surunkali bel og'rig'ini samarali boshqarish uchun kundalik dori-darmonlarni qabul qiladi.

prevention.s: Health experts always emphasize that disease prevention is better than cure.
prevention.u: Sog'liqni saqlash ekspertlari kasalliklarning profilaktikasi davolashdan ko'ra yaxshiroq ekanini doim ta'kidlaydilar.

patient.s: The doctor examined every patient carefully before writing a prescription today.
patient.u: Shifokor bugun retsept yozishdan oldin har bir bemorni sinchkovlik bilan tekshirdi.

cure.s: Scientists are still searching for a permanent cure for this rare disease.
cure.u: Olimlar haligacha ushbu noyob kasallikka doimiy davo topishga harakat qilmoqdalar.

headline.s: The main headline on the front page caught my attention immediately.
headline.u: Birinchi sahifadagi asosiy sarlavha darhol diqqatimni tortdi.

article.s: She wrote an interesting article about environmental protection for the magazine.
article.u: U jurnal uchun atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish haqida qiziqarli maqola yozdi.

journalist.s: The brave journalist spent months investigating corruption in the local government.
journalist.u: Jasur jurnalist mahalliy hukumatdagi korrupsiyani o‘rganish uchun oylar sarfladi.

source.s: The reporter refused to reveal the confidential source of the leaked information.
source.u: Muxbir sizib chiqqan maʼlumotning maxfiy manbasini oshkor qilishdan bosh tortdi.

report.s: We need to finish our financial report before the meeting tomorrow morning.
report.u: Ertalabki yig‘ilishdan oldin moliyaviy hisobotimizni tugatishimiz kerak.

broadcast.s: Millions of viewers tuned in for the live broadcast of the championship final.
broadcast.u: Millionlab tomoshabinlar chempionat finalining jonli efirini tomosha qilishdi.

bias.s: Good journalists must report the news without showing any political bias.
bias.u: Yaxshi jurnalistlar hech qanday siyosiy tarafkashlik ko‘rsatmasdan yangiliklarni yetkazishlari kerak.

objective.s: It is difficult for a researcher to remain completely objective during the experiment.
objective.u: Tadqiqotchi uchun tajriba davomida mutlaqo xolis qolish qiyin.

editor.s: The strict editor suggested several improvements to make the story much clearer.
editor.u: Talabchan muharrir hikoyani tushunarliroq qilish uchun bir nechta yaxshilanishlarni taklif qildi.

publish.s: The young author hopes to publish her first novel by the end of next year.
publish.u: Yosh yozuvchi kelgusi yilning oxirigacha o‘zining birinchi romanini nashr etishga umid qilmoqda.

audience.s: The speaker engaged the audience with fascinating stories from his travels abroad.
audience.u: Notiq chet elga qilgan sayohatlaridan qiziqarli hikoyalar bilan tomoshabinlarni jalb qildi.

circulation.s: The daily newspaper has seen a steady decline in its circulation numbers recently.
circulation.u: Kundalik gazetaning tarqatish soni oxirgi paytlarda barqaror ravishda kamayib bordi.

experiment.s: The students conducted a fascinating chemical experiment in the school science laboratory.
experiment.u: O‘quvchilar maktab fan laboratoriyasida qiziqarli kimyoviy tajriba o‘tkazdilar.

hypothesis.s: They tested their scientific hypothesis through a series of careful laboratory tests.
hypothesis.u: Ular ilmiy gipotezasini bir qator sinchkov laboratoriya sinovlari yordamida tekshirdilar.

theory.s: Albert Einstein is best known for developing his famous theory of relative physics.
theory.u: Albert Eynshteyn o‘zining mashhur nisbiylik nazariyasini ishlab chiqqani bilan mashhur.

analysis.s: A careful data analysis revealed surprising trends in consumer purchasing habits this year.
analysis.u: Maʼlumotlarni sinchkovlik bilan tahlil qilish joriy yilda isteʼmolchilarning xarid qilish odatlaridagi ajablanarli tendensiyalarni ochib berdi.

discovery.s: The accidental discovery of penicillin changed the history of modern medicine forever.
discovery.u: Penitsillinning tasodifiy kashf etilishi zamonaviy tibbiyot tarixini abadiy o‘zgartirib yubordi.

observation.s: Careful observation of animal behavior in the wild helps biologists understand them better.
observation.u: Yovvoyi tabiatda hayvonlar xulq-atvorini diqqat bilan kuzatish biologlarga ularni yaxshiroq tushunishga yordam beradi.

method.s: She developed a new teaching method that helps students learn foreign languages quickly.
method.u: U o‘quvchilarga chet tillarini tezroq o‘rganishga yordam beradigan yangi o‘qitish usulini ishlab chiqdi.

sample.s: The laboratory technician took a blood sample from the patient for further testing.
sample.u: Laboratoriya xodimi qo‘shimcha tekshiruv uchun bemordan qon namunasini oldi.

significant.s: The new research project led to significant improvements in regional public health.
significant.u: Yangi tadqiqot loyihasi hududiy aholi salomatligida sezilarli yaxshilanishlarga olib keldi.

community.s: Local residents worked together to build a safe playground for the neighborhood community.
community.u: Mahalliy aholi jamiyat uchun xavfsiz o‘yin maydonchasini qurish uchun birgalikda harakat qildilar.

neighbourhood.s: We live in a quiet residential neighbourhood with lots of green trees everywhere.
neighbourhood.u: Biz har yerda yashil daraxtlar ko‘p bo‘lgan tinch turar-joy mahallasida yashaymiz.

citizen.s: Every responsible citizen should participate in the upcoming local government elections.
citizen.u: Har bir masʼuliyatli fuqaro kelgusi mahalliy hokimiyat saylovlarida qatnashishi kerak.

degree.s: She is studying hard to get her university degree next year.
degree.u: U kelasi yili universitet diplomini olish uchun qattiq o'qiyapti.

lecture.s: The professor gave an interesting lecture about modern history this morning.
lecture.u: Professor bu tongda zamonaviy tarix haqida qiziqarli ma'ruza o'qidi.

seminar.s: Students discussed their project ideas during the small group seminar today.
seminar.u: Talabalar bugungi kichik guruh seminarida o'z loyiha g'oyalarini muhokama qilishdi.

assignment.s: We must submit our English writing assignment before Friday afternoon.
assignment.u: Biz ingliz tili yozma topshirig'imizni juma kunidan oldin topshirishimiz kerak.

research.s: Scientists do important research to find new treatments for diseases.
research.u: Olimlar kasalliklarga qarshi yangi davolash usullarini topish uchun muhim tadqiqot olib boradilar.

thesis.s: He spent six months writing his master thesis before graduation.
thesis.u: U o'qishni tugatishdan oldin magistrlik dissertatsiyasini yozishga olti oy sarfladi.

scholarship.s: She won a full scholarship to study at a famous university.
scholarship.u: U mashhur universitetda o'qish uchun to'liq stipendiyani qo'lga kiritdi.

tuition.s: Many students need to work part-time to pay their university tuition.
tuition.u: Ko'p talabalar universitet o'qish to'lovini to'lash uchun yarim stavkada ishlashlari kerak.

graduate.s: My brother will graduate from university with honours this coming June.
graduate.u: Mening akam kelayotgan iyun oyida universitetni imtiyozli diplom bilan bitiradi.

enrol.s: You need to enrol in the language course before the deadline.
enrol.u: Siz muddat tugagunga qadar til kursiga ro'yxatdan o'tishingiz kerak.

attend.s: It is very important for all students to attend every single class.
attend.u: Barcha talabalar uchun har bir darsda qatnashish juda muhimdir.

grade.s: She was happy to receive a good grade on her math test.
grade.u: U matematika testidan yaxshi baho olganidan xursand edi.

knowledge.s: Reading books every day helps to improve your general knowledge quickly.
knowledge.u: Har kuni kitob o'qish umumiy bilimingizni tezda oshirishga yordam beradi.

environment.s: We must all work together to protect our natural environment from destruction.
environment.u: Tabiiy muhitimizni buzilishdan himoya qilish uchun hammimiz birgalikda ishlashimiz kerak.

pollution.s: Air pollution in big cities causes serious health problems for many people.
pollution.u: Katta shaharlardagi havo ifloslanishi ko'p odamlarda jiddiy sog'liq muammolarini keltirib chiqaradi.

climate.s: Changes in the global climate affect farming and weather conditions worldwide.
climate.u: Global iqlimdagi o'zgarishlar butun dunyo bo'ylab dehqonchilik va ob-havo sharoitlariga ta'sir qiladi.

recycle.s: People should always separate their plastic bottles and paper to recycle them.
recycle.u: Odamlar ularni qayta ishlash uchun doimo plastik idishlari va qog'ozlarini ajratishlari kerak.

waste.s: We should reduce food waste by planning our meals carefully every week.
waste.u: Har hafta ovqatlarni diqqat bilan rejalashtirish orqali oziq-ovqat chiqindilarini kamaytirishimiz kerak.

energy.s: Turning off lights when you leave a room saves a lot of energy.
energy.u: Xonadan chiqayotganda chiroqlarni o'chirish ko'p energiya tejaydi.

solar.s: Many modern houses now use solar panels to generate clean electricity.
solar.u: Ko'pgina zamonaviy uylar endi toza elektr energiyasini ishlab chiqarish uchun quyosh panellaridan foydalanmoqda.

protect.s: Governments need to pass strict laws to protect endangered animals from hunters.
protect.u: Hukumatlar yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostida turgan hayvonlarni ovchilardan himoya qilish uchun qattiq qonunlar qabul qilishi kerak.

renewable.s: Wind and water are great sources of renewable energy for the future.
renewable.u: Shamol va suv kelajak uchun qayta tiklanuvchi energiyaning buyuk manbalaridir.

damage.s: The heavy storm caused severe damage to many houses in the town.
damage.u: Kuchli bo'ron shahardagi ko'plab uylarga jiddiy zarar etkazdi.

species.s: Scientists discovered a new species of fish living deep in the ocean.
species.u: Olimlar okeanning tubida yashovchi baliqning yangi turini kashf etdilar.

public transport.s: Many people prefer using public transport to avoid heavy morning traffic jams.
public transport.u: Ko‘pchilik ertalabki tirbandliklardan qochish uchun jamoat transportidan foydalanishni afzal ko‘radi.

infrastructure.s: The city government plans to invest more money in improving public infrastructure.
infrastructure.u: Shahar hukumati jamoat infratuzilmasini yaxshilashga ko‘proq pul kiritishni rejalashtirmoqda.

poverty.s: The charity organization works hard to reduce poverty in rural areas.
poverty.u: Xayriya tashkiloti qishloq joylarida qashshoqlikni kamaytirish ustida qattiq ishlaydi.

equality.s: Education plays a crucial role in promoting gender equality in society.
equality.u: Ta'lim jamiyatda gender tengligini targ'ib qilishda muhim rol o'ynaydi.

population.s: The population of this growing coastal town has doubled in ten years.
population.u: Bu rivojlanib borayotgan qirg'oq bo'yi shaharchasining aholisi o'n yil ichida ikki baravar ko'paydi.

facilities.s: Our university provides modern sports facilities for all students and staff.
facilities.u: Bizning universitetimiz barcha talabalar va xodimlar uchun zamonaviy sport qulayliklarini taqdim etadi.

crime.s: Installing more street lights significantly helped to reduce local crime rates.
crime.u: Ko‘proq ko‘cha chiroqlarini o‘rnatish mahalliy jinoyatchilik darajasini pasaytirishga sezilarli darajada yordam berdi.

safety.s: Workers must follow strict rules to ensure maximum safety on the construction site.
safety.u: Ishchilar qurilish maydonchasida maksimal xavfsizlikni ta'minlash uchun qat'iy qoidalarga amal qilishlari kerak.

volunteer.s: She decided to volunteer at the local animal shelter every weekend.
volunteer.u: U har dam olish kuni mahalliy hayvonlar boshpanasida ko'ngilli bo'lib ishlashga qaror qildi.

homeless.s: Several local charities provide warm meals and shelter for homeless people.
homeless.u: Bir nechta mahalliy xayriya tashkilotlari uysiz odamlarga issiq ovqat va boshpana beradi.

break the ice.s: He told a funny joke to break the ice at the meeting.
break the ice.u: U yig'ilishda muzni yorish uchun kulgili hazil aytdi.

once in a blue moon.s: My brother lives abroad, so I see him only once in a blue moon.
once in a blue moon.u: Akam chet elda yashaydi, shuning uchun uni juda kamdan-kam ko‘raman.

piece of cake.s: The final English exam was a piece of cake for all of us.
piece of cake.u: Yakuniy ingliz tili imtihoni hammimiz uchun juda oson ish bo'ldi.

hit the books.s: I cannot go out tonight because I need to hit the books for tomorrow.
hit the books.u: Bugun kechqurun tashqariga chiqa olmayman, chunki ertangi kun uchun kitob o'qishga kirishishim kerak.

under the weather.s: Sarah felt a bit under the weather yesterday, so she stayed home.
under the weather.u: Sara kecha o'zini biroz betob sezdi, shuning uchun uyda qoldi.

on the same page.s: We need a quick meeting to make sure everyone is on the same page.
on the same page.u: Hamma bir fikrda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilish uchun bizga qisqa uchrashuv kerak.

cost an arm and a leg.s: Buying a brand new sports car would cost an arm and a leg.
cost an arm and a leg.u: Mutlaqo yangi sport mashinasini sotib olish juda qimmatga tushadi.

keep an eye on.s: Could you please keep an eye on my luggage while I buy tickets?
keep an eye on.u: Men chipta sotib olgunimcha yukimga ko'z-quloq bo'lib tura olasizmi?

let the cat out of the bag.s: He accidentally let the cat out of the bag about the surprise party.
let the cat out of the bag.u: U kutilmagan ziyofat haqidagi sirni tasodifan ochib yubordi.

call it a day.s: We have been working for ten hours straight, so let's call it a day.
call it a day.u: Biz o'n soat tinimsiz ishladik, keling, bugunlik shu bilan to'xtatamiz.

get cold feet.s: He wanted to bungee jump, but he got cold feet at the last moment.
get cold feet.u: U baundji-jamping qilishni xohlagandi, lekin oxirgi daqiqada qo'rqib qoldi.

in hot water.s: Mark found himself in hot water after missing the important deadline.
in hot water.u: Mark muhim muddatni o'tkazib yuborganidan keyin muammoda qoldi.

better late than never.s: He finally apologized for his rude behavior, better late than never.
better late than never.u: U oxir-oqibat qo'pol xatti-harakati uchun kechirim so'radi, kech bo'lsa ham yaxshi.

cut corners.s: Do not cut corners when building a house, otherwise it might collapse.
cut corners.u: Uy qurayotganda ishni chala qilmang, aks holda u qulab tushishi mumkin.

rarely.s: Rarely do we see such a brilliant performance on stage.
rarely.u: Biz sahnada kamdan-kam bunday ajoyib chiqishni koʻramiz.

seldom.s: Seldom has the company witnessed such rapid financial growth.
seldom.u: Kompaniya kamdan-kam bunday tez moliyaviy oʻsishni boshdan kechirgan.

hardly.s: Hardly had I closed my eyes when the phone rang.
hardly.u: Koʻzlarimni zoʻrgʻa yumgan edimki, telefon jiringlab qoldi.

no sooner.s: No sooner had we arrived at the station than the train left.
no sooner.u: Biz stansiyaga yetib kelishimiz bilan poyezd joʻnab ketdi.

not only.s: Not only did she pass the exam, but she also got the highest score.
not only.u: U nafaqat imtihondan oʻtdi, balki eng yuqori ballni ham oldi.

little did.s: Little did he know that a surprise party was waiting for him.
little did.u: U oʻzini syurpriz ziyofat kutib turganidan mutlaqo bexabar edi.

under no circumstances.s: Under no circumstances should you share your password with anyone.
under no circumstances.u: Hech qanday holatda parolingizni hech kimga bermasligingiz kerak.

on no account.s: On no account must this confidential information be leaked to the press.
on no account.u: Bu maxfiy maʼlumot hech qachon matbuotga sizib chiqmasligi kerak.

never before.s: Never before had they experienced such harsh winter conditions.
never before.u: Ular ilgari hech qachon bunday qattiq qish sharoitini boshdan kechirmagan edilar.

scarcely.s: Scarcely had the meeting begun when the fire alarm went off.
scarcely.u: Yigʻilish boshlanishi bilan oʻt oʻchirish signali jiringlab ketdi.

barely.s: Barely able to keep his eyes open, he finished his essay.
barely.u: Koʻzlarini zoʻrgʻa ochib oʻtirib, u oʻz inshosini yozib tugatdi.

such was.s: Such was the intensity of the storm that roofs were blown off.
such was.u: Boʻronning shiddati shunday kuchli ediki, uylar tomlarini uchirib ketdi.

only when.s: Only when you lose your health do you truly appreciate its value.
only when.u: Faqat sogʻligingizni yoʻqotgandagina uning haqiqiy qadrini tushunasiz.

inversion.s: Inversion is often used in English for dramatic and stylistic effect.
inversion.u: Ingliz tilida teskari tartib koʻpincha taʼsirchanlik va uslubiy maqsadlarda ishlatiladi.

i wish.s: I wish I had accepted that job offer when I had the chance.
i wish.u: Qani edi imkoniyatim borida oʻsha ish taklifini qabul qilgan boʻlsam.

if only.s: If only we knew the truth before making such a big decision.
if only.u: Shunchalik katta qaror qabul qilishdan oldin haqiqatni bilganimizda edi.

were i.s: Were I in your position, I would definitely take up this challenge.
were i.u: Agar men sening oʻrningda boʻlganimda, albatta bu sinovni qabul qilgan boʻlardim.

demand.s: The angry customers demand an immediate explanation from the store manager.
demand.u: Jahli chiqqan mijozlar doʻkon rahbaridan darhol tushuntirish berishini talab qilmoqdalar.

insist.s: She always insists on paying the bill whenever we go out together.
insist.u: Biz birga tashqariga chiqqanimizda u har doim hisobni oʻzi toʻlashni talab qiladi.

it is essential.s: It is essential that every student submits their assignment before Friday.
it is essential.u: Har bir talaba oʻz vazifasini jumagacha topshirishi juda zarur.

if necessary.s: We can postpone the meeting until next week if necessary.
if necessary.u: Agar kerak boʻlsa, uchrashuvni kelgusi haftaga qoldirishimiz mumkin.

required.s: A valid passport and a visa are required for international travel.
required.u: Xalqaro sayohat uchun amal qiluvchi pasport va viza talab qilinadi.

hypothetical.s: Let us consider a hypothetical situation where resources are completely unlimited.
hypothetical.u: Keling, resurslar mutlaqo cheksiz boʻlgan faraziy vaziyatni koʻrib chiqaylik.

contrary.s: Contrary to popular belief, bats are actually very gentle and harmless animals.
contrary.u: Ommaviy tushunchaning aksincha, koʻrshapalaklar aslida juda yuvosh va zararsiz hayvonlardir.

unreal.s: The whole experience felt completely unreal, like something out of a dream.
unreal.u: Butun tajriba butunlay haqiqiy emasdek, go‘yo tushdagidek tuyuldi.

urge.s: She felt a strong urge to speak up and share her opinion.
urge.u: U o'z fikrini bildirish va gapirish uchun kuchli istakni his qildi.

it was … who.s: It was my close friend who helped me finish the difficult project.
it was … who.u: Qiyin loyihani tugatishimga yordam bergan aynan mening yaqin do'stim edi.

what i mean is.s: What I mean is that we should work smarter instead of harder.
what i mean is.u: Men nima demoqchiman, biz qattiqroq emas, balki aqlliroq ishlashimiz kerak.

the reason is.s: The reason is that production costs have increased significantly this year.
the reason is.u: Sabab shundaki, bu yil ishlab chiqarish xarajatlari sezilarli darajada oshdi.

the thing is.s: The thing is we simply do not have enough time to finish everything.
the thing is.u: Gap shundaki, bizda hamma narsani tugatish uchun shunchaki vaqt yetarli emas.

what matters is.s: What matters is that you learn from your mistakes and keep moving.
what matters is.u: Muhimi shundaki, siz xatolaringizdan saboq olib, harakatda davom etishingiz kerak.

what happened.s: I still cannot understand what happened during the meeting yesterday afternoon.
what happened.u: Kecha tushdan keyin yig‘ilishda nima bo‘lganini hali ham tushuna olmayapman.

the problem is.s: The problem is that we missed the deadline for the final submission.
the problem is.u: Muammo shundaki, biz yakuniy topshiriq uchun belgilangan muddatni o‘tkazib yubordik.

the truth is.s: The truth is that nobody expected the company to grow so fast.
the truth is.u: Haqiqat shundaki, hech kim kompaniyaning bunday tez o'sishini kutmagan edi.

the fact is.s: The fact is that modern technology has completely changed our daily lives.
the fact is.u: Fakt shundaki, zamonaviy texnologiyalar kundalik hayotimizni butunlay o'zgartirib yubordi.

emphasis.s: The teacher placed strong emphasis on proper pronunciation during the speaking class.
emphasis.u: O'qituvchi gapirish darsida to'g'ri talaffuzga alohida urg'u berdi.

focus.s: We need to maintain sharp focus on our main goals this semester.
focus.u: Biz bu semestrda asosiy maqsadlarimizga diqqatimizni qaratishimiz kerak.

highlight.s: The report aims to highlight the urgent need for better environmental protection.
highlight.u: Hisobot ekologik muhofazani yaxshilashning shoshilinch zarurligini ta'kidlashga qaratilgan.

stress.s: Excessive workload at the office can cause severe mental and physical stress.
stress.u: O'usdagi ortiqcha ish yuki jiddiy ruhiy va jismoniy stressni keltirib chiqarishi mumkin.

all i want.s: All I want is a quiet weekend to relax and read books.
all i want.u: Men faqat dam olish va kitob o'qish uchun tinch dam olish kunini istayman.

it is said that.s: It is said that this old castle holds many dark secrets inside.
it is said that.u: Aytilishicha, bu eski qasr ichida ko'plab qorong'u sirlarni saqlaydi.

it is believed that.s: It is believed that regular exercise significantly improves overall physical health.

correction.s: The teacher made a small correction in my English essay.
correction.u: O‘qituvchi mening inglizcha inshomda kichik tuzatish kiritdi.

slowly.s: Please speak more slowly so I can understand you.
slowly.u: Iltimos, sekinroq gapiring, shunda sizni tushuna olaman.

fits.s: This winter jacket fits me very well and feels warm.
fits.u: Bu qishki kurtka menga juda mos keladi va issiq.

meal.s: We usually eat a big family meal together on Sundays.
meal.u: Biz odatda yakshanba kunlari birga katta oilaviy ovqat tanovul qilamiz.

hurt.s: My right leg began to hurt after running this morning.
hurt.u: Bugun ertalab yugurganimdan keyin o‘ng oyog‘im og‘riy boshladi.

unlike.s: Unlike his brother, he prefers reading books in the evening.
unlike.u: Ukasidan farqli o‘laroq, u kechqurun kitob o‘qishni afzal ko‘radi.

silent.s: The classroom was completely silent during the important grammar test.
silent.u: Muhim grammatika testi paytida sinf xonasi mutlaqo jim edi.

literary.s: She loves reading classical literary books during her summer holidays.
literary.u: U yozgi ta’til paytida klassik adabiy kitoblarni o‘qishni yaxshi ko‘radi.

signals.s: Traffic signals help drivers stay safe on busy city streets.
signals.u: Yo‘l signallari haydovchilarga gavjum shahar ko‘chalarida xavfsiz yurishga yordam beradi.

choosing.s: Choosing the right university course is very important for your future.
choosing.u: To‘g‘ri universitet kursini tanlash kelajagingiz uchun juda muhimdir.

talent.s: He has a great musical talent and plays the guitar well.
talent.u: Uning katta musiqa iste’dodi bor va gitirani yaxshi chaladi.

believes.s: She always believes that hard work brings great success in life.
believes.u: U har doim mashaqqatli mehnat hayotda katta muvaffaqiyat keltirishiga ishonadi.

wash.s: Remember to wash your hands before you sit down to eat.
wash.u: Ovqatlanish uchun o‘tirishdan oldin qo‘llaringizni yuvishni unutmang.

declaration.s: The government made an important declaration about taxes this morning.
declaration.u: Hukumat bugun ertalab soliqlar haqida muhim deklaratsiya e’lon qildi.

advantages.s: Living in a small town has many advantages for young families.
advantages.u: Kichik shaharchada yashash yosh oilalar uchun ko‘plab afzalliklarga ega.

linking.s: Good transition words help in linking your ideas together smoothly.
linking.u: Yaxshi o‘tish so‘zlari fikrlaringizni bir-biriga ravon bog‘lashga yordam beradi.

illness.s: He stayed at home all week because of a bad illness.
illness.u: U og‘ir kasallik tufayli butun hafta uyda qoldi.

jam.s: I like spreading sweet strawberry jam on my toast for breakfast.
jam.u: Men nonushtaga tostimga shirin qulupnay murabbosini surtishni yoqtiraman.

answered.s: The smart student quickly answered all the difficult questions in class.
answered.u: Aqlli o‘quvchi sinfdagi barcha qiyin savollarga tezda javob berdi.

increasingly.s: Learning a second language is becoming increasingly important in modern business.
increasingly.u: Ikkinchi tilni o‘rganish zamonaviy biznesda kundan-kun muhim bo‘lib bormoqda.

routine.s: Having a healthy daily routine helps you stay energetic and focused.
routine.u: Sog‘lom kundalik odatiy tartibga ega bo‘lish energiyali va diqqatni jamlashga yordam beradi.

wearing.s: She was wearing a beautiful blue dress at the birthday party.
wearing.u: U tug‘ilgan kun kechasida chiroyli ko‘k ko‘ylak kiyib olgandi.

attitude.s: A positive attitude helps you overcome difficult challenges in your studies.
attitude.u: Ijobiy munosabat o‘qishdagi qiyin sinovlarni yengib o‘tishga yordam beradi.

falling.s: The brown leaves are falling from the trees in autumn.

explains.s: The teacher clearly explains the complex grammar rules to the students.
explains.u: O‘qituvchi o‘quvchilarga murakkab grammatika qoidalarini aniq tushuntiradi.

timing.s: Good timing is essential for making your presentation successful.
timing.u: Taqdimotingiz muvaffaqiyatli chiqishi uchun to‘g‘ri vaqtni belgilash juda muhim.

liked.s: Everyone liked the delicious homemade cake she brought to the party.
liked.u: U kechaga olib kelgan mazali uy qurilishi torti hammaga yoqqan.

twelve.s: There are twelve months in a standard calendar year.
twelve.u: Standart taqvim yilida o‘n ikki oy mavjud.

everywhere.s: We looked for my lost keys everywhere in the house.
everywhere.u: Biz yo‘qolgan kalitlarimizni uyning hamma joyidan qidirdik.

stood.s: She stood quietly by the window and watched the rain.
stood.u: U deraza yonida jim turgan holda yomg‘erni kuzatdi.

honest.s: It is always better to be honest about your mistakes.
honest.u: Xatolaringiz haqida doimo halol bo‘lganingiz yaxshiroqdir.

somebody.s: Somebody left their umbrella on the chair in the hallway.
somebody.u: Koridordagi stulga kimdir o‘z soyabonini tashlab ketibdi.

reputation.s: The company worked hard to build a strong reputation for quality.
reputation.u: Kompaniya sifat borasida mustahkam obro‘ orttirish uchun qattiq ishladi.

recycling.s: Our city has a very efficient recycling program for plastic bottles.
recycling.u: Shahrimizda plastik idishlar uchun juda samarali qayta ishlash dasturi bor.

criticism.s: She learned how to accept constructive criticism from her manager.
criticism.u: U menejeridan konstruktiv tanqidni qabul qilishni o‘rgandi.

decades.s: Scientists have studied these climate patterns for several decades.
decades.u: Olimlar ushbu iqlim o‘zgarishlarini bir necha o‘n yilliklar davomida o‘rganib chiqishdi.

paintings.s: The famous museum displays beautiful paintings by local artists.
paintings.u: Mashhur muzey mahalliy rassomlarning go‘zal rasmlarini namoyish etadi.

walked.s: They walked slowly through the quiet park on a sunny afternoon.
walked.u: Ular quyoshli tushdan keyin tinch park bo‘ylab sekin yurishdi.

populations.s: Large urban populations require efficient public transportation systems.
populations.u: Katta shahar aholisi samarali jamoat transporti tizimlarini talab qiladi.

afraid.s: He was afraid to speak in front of the large audience.
afraid.u: U katta auditoriya oldida gapirishdan qo‘rqqan edi.

mistake.s: Making a small mistake is a normal part of learning something new.
mistake.u: Kichik xato qilish yangi narsani o‘rganishning oddiy qismidir.

fewer.s: People prefer to buy cars that consume fewer fuel resources.
fewer.u: Odamlar kamroq yoqilg‘i resurslarini sarflaydigan mashinalarni sotib olishni afzal ko‘rishadi.

adjusted.s: She adjusted the office chair to make it more comfortable for working.
adjusted.u: U ishlash uchun qulayroq bo‘lishi uchun ofis stulini moslashtirmoq qildi.

perfectly.s: The new suit fit him perfectly for the important business meeting.
perfectly.u: Yangi kostyum muhim biznes uchrashuvi uchun unga mukammal darajada mos tushdi.

cultures.s: Traveling helps us understand and appreciate different traditions and cultures.
cultures.u: Sayohat qilish turli anʼana va madaniyatlarimizni tushunish va qadrlashga yordam beradi.

examined.s: The doctor carefully examined the patient before writing a prescription.
examined.u: Shifokor retsept yozishdan oldin bemorni diqqat bilan tekshirmoq qildi.

artificial.s: This fruit juice contains no artificial colors or added sugars.
artificial.u: Bu meva sharbati tarkibida sun’iy ranglar yoki qo‘shilgan shakar mavjud emas.

naturally.s: She spoke English very fluently and naturally during the presentation.
naturally.u: U taqdimot paytida inglizcha juda erkin va tabiiy gapirdi.

soup.s: My mother cooked a delicious hot vegetable soup for lunch.
soup.u: Onam tushlik uchun mazali issiq sabzavotli sho‘rva pishirdi.

broke.s: He accidentally broke his favorite coffee mug this morning.
broke.u: U bugun ertalab tasodifan o‘zining sevimli qahva stakanini sindirib qo‘ydi.

brilliant.s: She had a brilliant idea to solve the difficult problem.
brilliant.u: Uning qiyin muammoni hal qilish uchun ajoyib g‘oyasi bor edi.

spoken.s: Spoken English is often much more informal than written text.
spoken.u: Og‘zaki ingliz tili ko‘pincha yozma matnga qaraganda ancha norasmiy bo‘ladi.

stayed.s: They stayed at a cozy hotel near the city center.
stayed.u: Ular shahar markaziga yaqin qulay mehmonxonada qolishdi.

watched.s: We watched an interesting documentary about wildlife last night.
watched.u: Biz kecha kechqurun yovvoyi tabiat haqida qiziqarli hujjatli film tomosha qildik.

differ.s: My opinion on this matter tends to differ from yours.
differ.u: Bu masala bo‘yicha mening fikrim siznikidan farq qiladi.

candle.s: She lit a scented candle to create a relaxing atmosphere.
candle.u: U tinchlantiruvchi muhit yaratish uchun xushbo‘y sham yoqdi.

elegant.s: The actress wore an elegant black dress at the awards ceremony.
elegant.u: Aktrisa taqdirlash marosimida nafis qora ko‘ylak kiygandi.

sisters.s: My two younger sisters love reading books in their free time.
sisters.u: Mening ikki kichik singlim bo‘sh vaqtlarida kitob o‘qishni yaxshi ko‘radi.

critics.s: Film critics gave the new director's movie very positive reviews.
critics.u: Kino tanqidchilar yangi rejissyorning filmiga juda ijobiy taqrizlar berishdi.

thinks.s: She always thinks carefully before making an important decision.
thinks.u: U muhim qaror qabul qilishdan oldin har doim diqqat bilan o‘ylaydi.

harm.s: Eating too much processed sugar can cause serious harm to health.
harm.u: Juda ko‘p qayta ishlangan shakar iste'mol qilish sog‘likka jiddiy zarar etkazishi mumkin.

spotlight.s: The main singer stood alone under the bright spotlight on stage.
spotlight.u: Bosh yolg‘iz xonanda sahnadagi yorqin projektor nuri ostida yolg‘iz turdi.

repeated.s: The teacher repeated the difficult grammar rule for the students.
repeated.u: O‘qituvchi o‘quvchilar uchun qiyin grammatika qoidasini takrorladi.

honey.s: She likes to add a spoon of honey to her herbal tea.
honey.u: U o‘simlik choyiga bir qoshiq asal qo‘shishni yoqtiradi.

junction.s: Turn left at the next traffic light junction to reach the station.
junction.u: Vokzalga borish uchun keyingi svetoforli chorrahadan chapga buriling.

protecting.s: Governments must focus more on protecting endangered animal species worldwide.
protecting.u: Hukumatlar butun dunyo bo‘ylab yo‘qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi hayvon turlarini himoya qilishga ko‘proq e'tibor qaratishlari kerak.

produces.s: This local factory produces high-quality electronic devices for export.
produces.u: Bu mahalliy zavod eksport uchun yuqori sifatli elektron qurilmalar ishlab chiqaradi.

wait.s: Please wait for me near the entrance of the building.
wait.u: Iltimos, bino kirish eshigi yonida meni kuting.

studying.s: He spends hours studying library books to pass his exams.
studying.u: U imtihonlardan o‘tish uchun kutubxona kitoblarini o‘qishga soatlarchavaqt sarflaydi.

colleagues.s: She went out for lunch with her friendly office colleagues today.
colleagues.u: U bugun o‘zining mehribon idora hamkasblari bilan tushlikka chiqdi.

separated.s: The two brothers were separated during the war and never met again.
separated.u: Ikki aka-uka urush paytida bir-biridan ajratilgan va boshqa hech qachon uchrashmagan.

heritage.s: We must protect our cultural heritage for future generations.
heritage.u: Kelajak avlodlar uchun madaniy merosimizni asrab-avaylashimiz kerak.

national.s: The national team won the important football match yesterday.
national.u: Milliy jamoa kecha muhim futbol o'yinida g'alaba qozondi.

costume.s: She wore a traditional national costume at the festival.
costume.u: U festivalda an'anaviy milliy libos kiygan edi.

guest.s: We invited our best friends to be our dinner guests.
guest.u: Biz eng yaxshi do'stlarimizni kechki ovqat mehmoni bo'lishga taklif qildik.

hospitality.s: People in this village are famous for their great hospitality.
hospitality.u: Bu qishloq odamlari o'zlarining buyuk mehmonnavozligi bilan mashhur.

journey.s: Our long train journey across the country took three days.
journey.u: Mamlakat bo'ylab qilgan uzoq poezd sayohatimiz uch kun davom etdi.

destination.s: We finally reached our holiday destination after driving all night.
destination.u: Butun tunda haydab, nihoyat dam olish manzilimizga yetib keldik.

departure.s: Please check the departure time on your ticket before leaving.
departure.u: Ketishdan oldin chiptangizdagi jo'nash vaqtini tekshirib ko'ring.

arrival.s: Everyone waited at the airport gate for the safe arrival.
arrival.u: Hamma xavfsiz kelishni kutib aeroport darvozasida turgan edi.

delay.s: Bad weather caused a significant flight delay at the airport.
delay.u: Yomon ob-havo aeroportda parvozning jiddiy kechikishiga sabab bo'ldi.

book.s: You need to book your hotel room well in advance.
book.u: Mehmonxona xonangizni oldindan yaxshilab band qilishingiz kerak.

accommodation.s: The price of our holiday includes both flights and comfortable accommodation.
accommodation.u: Ta'tilimiz narxi ham parvozlarni, ham qulay turar joyni o'z ichiga oladi.

sightseeing.s: We spent the whole afternoon doing sightseeing in the old city.
sightseeing.u: Biz butun tushdan keyinni eski shaharda diqqatga sazovor joylarni tomosha qilish bilan o'tkazdik.

souvenir.s: I bought a small wooden souvenir to remember this wonderful trip.
souvenir.u: Men bu ajoyib safarni eslash uchun kichik yog'och sovg'a sotib oldim.

local.s: We asked a friendly local person for directions to the museum.
local.u: Biz muzeyga boradigan yo'lni do'stona mahalliy odamdan so'radik.

customs.s: We had to open our bags at customs after landing.
customs.u: Yerga qo'nganimizdan keyin bojxonada sumkalarimizni ochishimiz kerak edi.

trip.s: Our school trip to the mountains was extremely fun and educational.
trip.u: Maktabimizning tog'larga qilgan safari juda qiziqarli va ta'limiy bo'ldi.

opinion.s: Everyone in the room shared their honest opinion about the movie.
opinion.u: Xonadagi hamma kino haqida o'zining halol fikrini bildirdi.

disagree.s: It is completely normal for friends to disagree on some topics.
disagree.u: Do'stlarning ayrim mavzularda o'zaro qo'shilmasligi mutlaqo oddiy holat.

argument.s: He presented a strong argument to support his unusual business idea.
argument.u: U o'zining g'ayrioddiy biznes g'oyasini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun kuchli dalil keltirdi.

point.s: I understand your main point, but I still have some doubts.
point.u: Men asosiy nuqtangizni tushunib turibman, lekin baribir ba'zi shubhalarim bor.

however.s: She wanted to go for a walk; however, it started raining.
however.u: U sayr qilishni xohlagandi; biroq yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.

therefore.s: He missed his morning alarm and therefore arrived late to work.
therefore.u: U tonggi budilnikini o'tkazib yubordi va shuning uchun ishga kech qoldi.

moreover.s: The restaurant offers great food; moreover, the prices are very cheap.
moreover.u: Restoran ajoyib ovqat taklif qiladi; bundan tashqari, narxlari juda arzon.

supposedly.s: Supposedly, the new manager will introduce stricter policies next month.
supposedly.u: Taxminan, yangi menejer kelasi oy qattiqroq siyosatlarni joriy qiladi.

widely considered.s: She is widely considered one of the best contemporary artists today.
widely considered.u: U bugungi kunda eng yaxshi zamonaviy san'atkorlardan biri deb keng hisoblanadi.

be held.s: The annual international conference is scheduled to be held in Tashkent.
be held.u: Yillik xalqaro anjuman Toshkentda o'tkazilishi rejalashtirilgan.

be regarded.s: His latest novel should be regarded as a masterpiece of modern literature.
be regarded.u: Uning so'nggi romani zamonaviy adabiyotning shoh asari sifatida hisoblanishi kerak.

be expected.s: All department heads are expected to attend the urgent meeting tomorrow.
be expected.u: Barcha bo'lim rahbarlari ertangi shoshilinch yig'ilishda qatnashishi kutilmoqda.

be required.s: Advanced proficiency in English is required for this demanding position.
be required.u: Ushbu talabchan lavozim uchun ingliz tilini mukammal bilish talab qilinadi.

furthermore.s: Furthermore, the research findings provide strong evidence supporting our initial hypothesis.
furthermore.u: Bundan tashqari, tadqiqot natijalari dastlabki gipotezamizni tasdiqlovchi kuchli dalillarni taqdim etadi.

nevertheless.s: The weather conditions were terrible; nevertheless, they completed the mountain trek.
nevertheless.u: Ob-havo sharoiti juda yomon edi; shunga qaramay, ular tog' sayohatini yakunladilar.

consequently.s: Production delays occurred, and consequently, the delivery date was postponed.
consequently.u: Ishlab chiqarish kechiktirildi va natijada yetkazib berish sanasi qoldirildi.

in contrast.s: Urban areas are densely populated, while rural regions, in contrast, are quiet.
in contrast.u: Shahar joylari zich joylashgan, qishloq hududlari esa aksincha tinch.

substantial.s: The company reported a substantial increase in quarterly profits this year.
substantial.u: Kompaniya bu yil choraklik foydaning sezilarli darajada oshganini e'lon qildi.

framework.s: We need to establish a clear legal framework before launching the project.
framework.u: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin aniq huquqiy doirani o'rnatishimiz kerak.

implication.s: The economic implications of this new policy remain largely uncertain today.
implication.u: Ushbu yangi siyosatning iqtisodiy oqibatlari bugungi kunda ham noma'lumligicha qolmoqda.

analyse.s: Scientists continue to analyse the complex data gathered from the experiment.
analyse.u: Olimlar tajribadan to'plangan murakkab ma'lumotlarni tahlil qilishda davom etmoqdalar.

demonstrate.s: The successful trial will demonstrate the effectiveness of the new vaccine.
demonstrate.u: Muvaffaqiyatli sinov yangi vakschaning samaradorligini ko'rsatib beradi.

argue.s: Experts strongly argue that climate change requires immediate global political action.
argue.u: Mutaxassislar iqlim o'zgarishi zudlik bilan global siyosiy harakatni talab qilishini qattiq dalillamoqdalar.

cite.s: Researchers always cite reliable academic sources in their published scientific papers.
cite.u: Tadqiqotchilar o'zlarining chop etilgan ilmiy maqolalarida doimo ishonchli akademik manbalarga iqtisod keltiradilar.

conclude.s: The committee will conclude their lengthy investigation by the end of Friday.
conclude.u: Qo'mita juma kunining oxirigacha o'zlarining uzoq davom etgan tergovini xulosa qiladi.

persuade.s: The marketing team managed to persuade the investors to fund the startup.
persuade.u: Marketing guruhi investorlarni startapni moliyalashtirishga ishontirishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.

structure.s: You must improve the structural organization of your essay before submission.
structure.u: Topshirishdan oldin inshongizning tuzilmasini yaxshilashingiz kerak.

introduction.s: A strong introduction should clearly state the main objective of your research.
introduction.u: Kuchli kirish qismi tadqiqotingizning asosiy maqsadini aniq ko'rsatishi kerak.

engage.s: Good teachers try to engage all students in interactive classroom activities.
engage.u: Yaxshi o'qituvchilar barcha o'quvchilarni darsdagi o'zaro harakatlarga jalb qilishga harakat qilishadi.

confidence.s: Public speaking practice helps students build confidence in their communication skills.
confidence.u: Ommaviy nutq amaliyoti o'quvchilarga muloqot ko'nikmalarida ishonch hosil qilishga yordam beradi.

pause.s: The speaker took a brief pause before answering the difficult question.
pause.u: Noutq so'zlovchi qiyin savolga javob berishdan oldin qisqa to'xtam qildi.

gesture.s: His polite gesture during the meeting created a very positive atmosphere.
gesture.u: Uning uchrashuvdagi odobli ishorasi juda ijobiy muhit yaratdi.

credibility.s: The expert established strong credibility by presenting accurate financial data to everyone.
credibility.u: Mutaxassis barchaga aniq moliyaviy ma'lumotlarni taqdim etib, kuchli ishonchlilikni o'rnatdi.

clarity.s: The manager explained the new project goals with remarkable clarity and precision.
clarity.u: Menejer yangi loyiha maqsadlarini ajoyib aniqlik va ravshanlik bilan tushuntirdi.

rapport.s: Building strong rapport with clients is essential for long-term business success.
rapport.u: Mijozlar bilan kuchli aloqa o'rnatish uzoq muddatli biznes muvaffaqiyati uchun muhimdir.

compromise.s: Both sides had to make a difficult compromise to reach a final decision.
compromise.u: Yakuniy qarorga kelish uchun har ikki tomon qiyin murosaga kelishi kerak edi.

proposal.s: The board of directors reviewed the business proposal before making any decision.
proposal.u: Direktorlar kengashi biron bir qaror qabul qilishdan oldin biznes taklifini ko'rib chiqdi.

counter-offer.s: She rejected their initial price and submitted a reasonable counter-offer immediately.
counter-offer.u: U ularning dastlabki narxini rad etdi va darhol oqilona qarshi taklif taqdim etdi.

agreement.s: They finally signed a formal agreement after hours of intense negotiations.
agreement.u: Ular bir necha soatlik qizg'in muzokaralardan so'ng nihoyat rasmiy kelishuvni imzoladilar.

terms.s: We need to carefully review all financial terms before signing the contract.
terms.u: Shartnomani imzolashdan oldin barcha moliyaviy shartlarni diqqat bilan ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak.

concession.s: Making a small concession helped them move forward with the difficult negotiations.
concession.u: Kichik yon berish ularga qiyin muzokaralar bilan oldinga siljishga yordam berdi.

leverage.s: Our strong market position gave us enough leverage to negotiate better prices.
leverage.u: Bizning kuchli bozor mavqeyimiz yaxshiroq narxlarni kelishib olish uchun yetarli ta'sir kuchini berdi.

counterparty.s: We must ensure the counterparty fully understands all obligations in the contract.
counterparty.u: Biz qarshi tomon shartnomadagi barcha majburiyatlarni to'liq tushunishini ta'minlashimiz kerak.

mutual.s: The partnership was based on mutual trust and shared professional business goals.
mutual.u: Hamkorlik o'zaro ishonch va umumiy professional biznes maqsadlariga asoslangan edi.

feasible.s: The engineers proved that the new construction plan was completely feasible.
feasible.u: Muhandislar yangi qurilish rejasi to'liq amalga oshirish mumkinligini isbotladilar.

walk away.s: Sometimes it is better to walk away than accept an unfair deal.
walk away.u: Ba'zida adolatsiz bitimni qabul qilgandan ko'ra kelishuvdan voz kelish yaxshiroqdir.

commitment.s: Signing this document requires a long-term financial commitment from our company.
commitment.u: Ushbu hujjatni imzolash kompaniyamizdan uzoq muddatli moliyaviy majburiyatni talab qiladi.

novel.s: She spent several years writing a historical novel about the ancient silk road.
novel.u: U qadimiy ipak yo'li haqida tarixiy roman yozish uchun bir necha yil sarfladi.

plot.s: The mystery novel had a complex plot that surprised readers until the end.
plot.u: Detektiv roman oxirigacha o'quvchilarni hayratda qoldirgan murakkab syujetga ega edi.

character.s: Every main character in the story goes through significant personal growth.
character.u: Hikoyadagi har bir asosiy qahramon muhim shaxsiy o'sish jarayonidan o'tadi.

narrative.s: The author uses a unique narrative style to explore complex human emotions.
narrative.u: Muallif murakkab insoniy hissiyotlarni o'rganish uchun o'ziga xos bayon uslubidan foydalanadi.

metaphor.s: The poet used a sailing ship as a metaphor for human life journey.
metaphor.u: Shoir inson hayoti sayohati uchun ramziy ma'noda elkanli kemadan metafora sifatida foydalandi.

symbol.s: In many cultures, the white dove is traditionally recognized as a symbol of peace.
symbol.u: Ko'p madaniyatlarda oq kaptar an'anaviy ravishda tinchlik ramzi sifatida tan olinadi.

staff.s: The hotel staff were extremely helpful and polite to us.

share.s: It is important to share your thoughts and feelings with friends.

witnesses.s: Police officers questioned several eyewitnesses to gather important clues about the accident.

shopping bag.s: Always bring a reusable shopping bag when you go to town.

shopping cart.s: Push the shopping cart while we walk down the aisles.

shopping list.s: Write down everything you need on a shopping list.
shopping list.u: Sizga kerak bo'lgan hamma narsani xaridlar ro'yxatiga yozib qo'ying.

special offer.s: This coffee comes with a special offer this weekend.
special offer.u: Bu kofe dam olish kunlari maxsus taklif bilan beriladi.

spend money.s: It is not wise to spend money on useless things.

store detective.u: Do‘kon qo‘riqchisi shubhali xaridorning ortidan juda diqqat bilan kuzatdi.

too expensive.s: We decided not to buy the car because it was too expensive.
too expensive.u: Mashina juda qimmat bo'lgani uchun uni sotib olmaslikka qaror qildik.

waste money.s: Playing video games all day is just a complete waste money.
waste money.u: Butun kun video o'yin o'ynash bu shunchaki pulni sovurmoq.

window shopping.u: Ular tushdan keyin shahar markazida do‘kon derazalariga qarab yurish bilan o‘tkazishdi.

warm sunshine.s: We enjoyed the warm sunshine in the park.

natural disaster.s: People must prepare for any sudden natural disaster.

dark clouds.s: Dark clouds appeared quickly in the evening sky.
dark clouds.u: Kechki osmonda tezda qora bulutlar paydo bo'ldi.

bright sun.s: The bright sun shone over the green valley.
bright sun.u: Yashil vodiy uzra porloq quyosh charaqlab turdi.

morning dew.s: Morning dew covered the grass in our garden.
morning dew.u: Ertalabki shabnam bog'imizdagi o'tlarni qoplab oldi.

rise in temperature.s: We noticed a quick rise in temperature today.
rise in temperature.u: Biz bugun haroratning tez ko'tarilishini sezdik.

degree above zero.s: The afternoon temperature reached ten degrees above zero.
degree above zero.u: Tushdan keyin harorat nol darajadan o'n daraja yuqori bo'ldi.

raincoat.s: She forgot to wear her yellow raincoat today.
raincoat.u: U bugun sariq yomg'irpo'shini kiyishni unutib qo'ydi.

snowstorm.s: A big snowstorm closed all the roads home.
snowstorm.u: Katta bo'ron uydagi barcha yo'llarni yopib qo'ydi.

snowflake.s: Every tiny snowflake has a very unique shape.
snowflake.u: Har bir mittigina qor parchasi o'ziga xos shaklga ega.

icicle.s: A long icicle hung from the roof edge.
icicle.u: Tom chetidan uzun muz parchasi osilib turgandi.

puddle.s: The children jumped happily into every large puddle.
puddle.u: Bolalar har bir katta ko'lmakka xursand bo'lib sakrashdi.

fallen leaf.s: He picked up a yellow fallen leaf today.
fallen leaf.u: U bugun sariq rangli to'kilgan bargni oldi.

thick forest.s: Many wild animals live inside this thick forest.
thick forest.u: Bu qalin o'rmon ichida ko'plab yovvoyi hayvonlar yashaydi.

mountain peak.s: Snow covered the high mountain peak all year.
mountain peak.u: Qor baland tog' cho'qqisini butun yil davomida qoplab turadi.

fast river.s: A fast river flows down the green valley.
fast river.u: Tez daryo yashil vodiy bo'ylab pastga oqib tushadi.

wide sea.s: Large ships travel across the wide blue sea.
wide sea.u: Katta kemalar keng ko'k dengiz bo'ylab suzib yuradi.

ocean wave.s: An ocean wave crashed loudly against the rocks.
ocean wave.u: Okean to'lqini qoyalarga baland ovoz bilan urildi.

rocky cliff.s: Birds made their nests on the rocky cliff.
rocky cliff.u: Qushlar o'z uyalarini qoyali qirg'oqqa qurishdi.

waterfall.s: We heard the loud noise of the waterfall.

starry night.s: We looked at the stars during the starry night.
starry night.u: Biz yulduzli tun paytida yulduzlarga qarab o'tirdik.

martial arts.s: He practices martial arts at the local gym every weekend.
martial arts.u: U har dam olish kuni mahalliy sport zalida jang sanʼati bilan shugʻullanadi.

board game.s: We like to play a fun board game on Friday evenings.
board game.u: Biz juma oqshomlarida qiziqarli stol oʻynashni yaxshi koʻramiz.

track and field.s: She runs very fast and loves track and field sports.
track and field.u: U juda tez yuguradi va yengil atletika sportini yaxshi koʻradi.

water sports.s: Swimming and sailing are very popular summer water sports.
water sports.u: Suzish va yelkanli qayiqda suzish juda mashhur yozgi suv sporti turlaridir.

team spirit.s: Good team spirit helps us win difficult basketball matches.
team spirit.u: Yaxshi jamoa ruhi bizga qiyin basketbol oʻyinlarida gʻalaba qozonishga yordam beradi.

personal best.s: He was very happy to set a new personal best today.
personal best.u: U bugun yangi shaxsiy rekord oʻrnatganidan juda xursand edi.

fitness tracker.s: My fitness tracker counts every step I take all day.
fitness tracker.u: Mening fitness bilaguzugim kun boʻyi qoʻygan har bir qadamimni sanaydi.

warm up.s: Always warm up properly before you start running outside.
warm up.u: Tashqarida yugurishni boshlashdan oldin doimo yaxshilab qizib oling.

work out.s: I like to work out at the gym on Tuesdays.
work out.u: Men seshanba kunlari sport zalida shugʻullanishni yaxshi koʻraman.

sign up for.s: She wants to sign up for an art class soon.
sign up for.u: U tez orada rasm chizish darsiga roʻyxatdan oʻtmoqchi.

join a club.s: It is a great idea to join a club at school.
join a club.u: Maktabda biron bir klubga aʼzo boʻlish – ajoyib fikr.

score a goal.s: He kicked the ball hard and managed to score a goal.
score a goal.u: U toʻpni qattiq tepdi va gol urishga muvaffaq boʻldi.

win a match.s: Our team played very well to win the final match.
win a match.u: Jamoamiz final oʻyinida gʻalaba qozonish uchun juda yaxshi oʻynadi.

lose a game.s: It is sad to lose a game, but we tried hard.
lose a game.u: Oʻyinda yutqazish qaygʻuli, ammo biz qattiq harakat qildik.

draw a game.s: Neither team could score, so they had to draw a game.
draw a game.u: Ikki jamoa ham gol ura olmadi, shuning uchun ular durang oʻynashga majbur boʻlishdi.

kick a ball.s: The little boy loves to kick a ball in the yard.
kick a ball.u: Kichkina bola hovlida toʻpni tepishni yaxshi koʻradi.

throw a ball.s: Can you throw a ball to your friend across the yard?
throw a ball.u: Hovli narigi betidagi doʻstingizga toʻpni otib bera olasizmi?

catch a ball.s: He jumped high into the air to catch a ball.
catch a ball.u: U toʻpni tutib olish uchun havoga baland sakradi.

ride a bike.s: Children love to ride a bike with their friends outside.
ride a bike.u: Bolalar tashqarida doʻstlari bilan velosiped haydashni yaxshi koʻradilar.

do yoga.s: Many people do yoga in the morning to relax.
do yoga.u: Koʻp odamlar dam olish uchun ertalab yoga bilan shugʻullanadilar.

do karate.s: My younger brother wants to do karate after school.
do karate.u: Kichik ukam maktabdan keyin karate bilan shugʻullanmoqchi.

play chess.s: Grandfather likes to sit quietly and play chess with me.
play chess.u: Bobo tinch oʻtirib, men bilan shaxmat oʻynashni yaxshi koʻradi.

play cards.s: We sometimes sit by the fireplace and play cards together.
play cards.u: Biz baʼzida kamin yonida oʻtirib, birgalikda qarta oʻynaymiz.

listen to music.s: She likes to listen to music while doing her homework.

setting sun.s: The sky is red and orange with the setting sun.

muddy path.s: My shoes got dirty on the muddy path.

gas station.s: Let us stop at the gas station to buy some water.

city map.u: Men muzeyni topish uchun shahar xaritasiga qarayapman.

hotel reception.u: Siz mehmonxona maʼmuriyatidan qo'shimcha sochiqlar so'rashingiz mumkin.

wake up call.s: I requested a morning wake up call at the reception.

declare goods.s: Passengers must declare goods at customs when entering a new country.

to sign off.s: The manager needs to sign off on this budget report today.

to think outside the box.s: We need to think outside the box to solve this difficult problem.

to pull one's weight.s: Everyone on the team must pull their weight to finish on time.
to pull one's weight.u: Vaqtida tugatish uchun jamoadagi har bir kishi o'z ulushini qo'shishi kerak.

to ball is in your court.s: I made my offer, so now the ball is in your court.

to call it a day.s: We have been working for ten hours, let us call it a day.
to call it a day.u: Biz o'n soatdan beri ishlayapmiz, keling, ishni shu yerda yakunlaymiz.

to go back to the drawing board.s: Our first plan failed, so we must go back to the drawing board.
